similar_in_english: the house is on fire (indicating a crisis)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সংসারে গৃহদাহ লেগেছে, সবাই দুঃখী।
এই ঘটনার পর তার জীবনে গৃহদাহ ঘটেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: A fire has broken out in his household, leaving everyone in distress.
After the incident, a calamity befell his family life.
note: This idiom draws from the literal imagery of a house fire as a metaphor for irreversible family disasters in Bengali culture.
